grain_rationale: The profile reports row_count 166158 and duplicate_row_rate 0.0 for silver.silver_flights, meaning no exact duplicate rows exist and each row represents a single scheduled flight departure, so the category is transaction-grained rather than aggregated. No single column is unique on its own (flight_number has only 2994 distinct values against 166158 rows), so the identity is derived from the ordered tuple flight_date, carrier_code, flight_number, origin_airport, dest_airport, which together uniquely identify each flight occurrence; because duplicate_row_rate is already 0.0, this tuple needs no deduplication to absorb repeats.

fields.name: flight_date
fields.description: Calendar date of the scheduled flight, ranging from 2013-01-01 to 2013-06-30 with 181 distinct values and null_rate 0.0, labeling the day of operation rather than timestamping the event at the finest grain.

fields.name: carrier_code
fields.description: Two-letter IATA carrier code, one of 16 distinct values such as 9E, AA, DL, with null_rate 0.0, labeling which airline operated the flight.

fields.name: flight_number
fields.description: Flight number assigned by the carrier, ranging 1-8500 across 2994 distinct values and null_rate 0.0; it identifies a flight rather than measuring anything, so it is not summed.

fields.name: origin_airport
fields.description: Origin airport code, one of 3 distinct values (EWR, JFK, LGA), null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: sched_dep_hhmm
fields.description: Scheduled departure time encoded as HHMM, ranging 500-2359 across 969 distinct values and null_rate 0.0; it is a time-of-day label, not a measure.

fields.name: dest_airport
fields.description: Destination airport code with 100 distinct values such as ABQ, ACK, ALB, and null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: tail_number
fields.description: Aircraft registration tail number with 3825 distinct values such as N0EGMQ; null_rate 0.009154 reflects flights where the tail number was not recorded, for example cancellations.

fields.name: is_cancelled
fields.description: Flag indicating whether the flight was cancelled, with distinct values true/false and null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: dep_hhmm
fields.description: Actual departure time encoded as HHMM, ranging 1-2400; null_rate 0.029388 reflects flights that never actually departed, consistent with is_cancelled.

fields.name: dep_delay_minutes
fields.description: Departure delay in minutes, ranging -33 to 1301 across 469 distinct values, summed and averaged across flights to measure on-time performance; null_rate 0.029388 matches flights with no recorded departure time.

fields.name: arr_hhmm
fields.description: Actual arrival time encoded as HHMM, ranging 1-2400; null_rate 0.0307 reflects flights that never recorded an arrival.

fields.name: sched_arr_hhmm
fields.description: Scheduled arrival time encoded as HHMM, ranging 1-2359 across 1134 distinct values, null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: arr_delay_minutes
fields.description: Arrival delay in minutes, ranging -86 to 1272, used to measure lateness across flights; null_rate 0.032981 for flights lacking a recorded arrival.

fields.name: air_time_minutes
fields.description: Time spent airborne in minutes, ranging 20-695, summed and averaged per flight to measure flight duration; null_rate 0.032981 matches flights without a recorded arrival.

fields.name: distance_miles
fields.description: Great-circle distance flown in miles, ranging 80-4983 with null_rate 0.0, summed and averaged to measure distance travelled.

fields.name: sched_dep_hour_local
fields.description: Local scheduled departure hour, one of 19 distinct values from 5 to 23, null_rate 0.0; it is a time-of-day label derived from the schedule.

fields.name: sched_dep_minute_local
fields.description: Local scheduled departure minute, ranging 0-59 across 60 distinct values, null_rate 0.0; it is a time-of-day label.

fields.name: departure_hour_utc
fields.description: UTC timestamp of scheduled departure truncated to the hour, ranging from 2013-01-01T10:00:00 to 2013-07-01T03:00:00 across 3439 distinct hourly values with null_rate 0.0; samples show only on-the-hour values, so hour is the finest grain the data resolves.

fields.name: carrier_name
fields.description: Full carrier name, one of 16 distinct values such as Delta Air Lines Inc. and American Airlines Inc., null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: aircraft_manufacturer
fields.description: Aircraft manufacturer, one of 34 distinct values such as AIRBUS and BOEING; null_rate 0.160426 for flights lacking matched aircraft registration data.

fields.name: aircraft_model
fields.description: Aircraft model, one of 121 distinct values such as 172E and 310Q; null_rate 0.160426 matching aircraft_manufacturer's nulls for unmatched registrations.

fields.name: aircraft_manufacture_year
fields.description: Year the aircraft was manufactured, ranging 1956-2013; null_rate 0.176531 for unmatched aircraft records, and it labels a vintage rather than measuring a flight event.

fields.name: aircraft_seat_count
fields.description: Number of seats on the aircraft, ranging 2-450, summed and averaged to measure fleet capacity; null_rate 0.160426 matches unmatched aircraft records.

fields.name: aircraft_engine_type
fields.description: Aircraft engine type, one of 6 distinct values such as Turbo-fan and Turbo-jet; null_rate 0.160426 matching unmatched aircraft records.

fields.name: origin_airport_name
fields.description: Full origin airport name, one of 3 distinct values (John F. Kennedy International Airport, LaGuardia Airport, Newark Liberty International Airport), null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: origin_municipality
fields.description: Origin municipality, one of 2 distinct values (New York, Newark), null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: origin_elevation_ft
fields.description: Origin airport elevation in feet, one of 3 distinct values (13, 18, 21), null_rate 0.0; a fixed airport attribute rather than a per-flight measure.

fields.name: origin_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Origin airport's longest runway length in feet, one of 3 distinct values (7002, 11000, 14511), null_rate 0.0; a fixed airport attribute.

fields.name: dest_airport_name
fields.description: Full destination airport name, one of 99 distinct values such as Akron Canton Regional Airport; null_rate 0.02089 for destinations not matched to an airport reference.

fields.name: dest_municipality
fields.description: Destination municipality, one of 95 distinct values such as Aguadilla and Akron; null_rate 0.02089 matching dest_airport_name's nulls.

fields.name: dest_iso_region
fields.description: Destination ISO region code, one of 45 distinct values such as US-AL and PR-U-A; null_rate 0.02089 matching unmatched destinations.

fields.name: dest_elevation_ft
fields.description: Destination airport elevation in feet, ranging 3-6606; null_rate 0.02089 matching unmatched destinations, a fixed airport attribute rather than a per-flight measure.

fields.name: dest_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Destination airport's longest runway length in feet, ranging 5076-16000; null_rate 0.02089 matching unmatched destinations.

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: Processing capture timestamp recorded at ingestion, with 16 distinct values clustered between 2026-09-02T23:25:51 and 2026-09-02T23:26:06 and null_rate 0.0; it reflects pipeline capture time rather than the business event, so it is not the designated time field.

category_description: One row represents a single scheduled flight departure from a New York-area airport (EWR, JFK, or LGA), identified by its flight date, carrier, flight number, origin, and destination, carrying its scheduling, timing, delay, aircraft, and airport reference details.
purpose: This mapping declares how the contracted silver.silver_flights table enters the gold unified event star as the flights fact category, specifying the time column, grain, identity, and field roles that the deterministic modeling engine consumes to generate the gold models; it is not itself an executable transform.
usage: The rendered mapping contract is validated by the frozen mapping-contract schema, checked by a validator and datacontract lint for groundedness and grain consistency, and reviewed and edited by a human before approval; only then does the modeling engine read it to emit gold fact and dimension models.
limitations: This mapping does not decide whether cancelled flights (flagged by is_cancelled) or flights with missing departure/arrival times (null_rate 0.029388-0.032981 on dep_hhmm, arr_hhmm, and related delay columns) should be excluded from downstream analysis; it also leaves aircraft-attribute nulls (null_rate 0.160426-0.176531 on aircraft_manufacturer, aircraft_model, aircraft_manufacture_year, aircraft_seat_count, and aircraft_engine_type) and destination-reference nulls (null_rate 0.02089) for consumers to handle, and it proposes no quality rules, classifications, or transformations beyond the declared identity tuple.
